response.text:
Recent work supports separating explanation appeal, evidence support, and actionable relevance. [ConSiDERS-The-Human (ACL 2024)](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.63/) recommends clear annotation guidelines, independent judgments, simpler questions, and agreement checks; fluent explanations can bias perceived truthfulness. A [2025 movie-recommendation study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03376) found positive-only explanations preferred by 129 participants, but familiarity and presentation confounds limit interpretation: persuasive wording does not establish personalized relevance. [AbstentionBench (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09038) demonstrates persistent failures on underspecified and unanswerable questions, supporting an explicit insufficient-information option.

Practical adaptation for the twenty designated users: record choose-now acceptance, explicit rejection, or insufficient information, with the stated reason and exact supporting history/title/description spans. Separately annotate each explanation claim as supported, contradicted, or unverifiable; record redundancy only when duplicate identity or overlapping content is evidenced. Ownership, compatibility, mood, current need, and diversity/conformity traits remain unknown unless explicitly established. Metadata can establish an item attribute without establishing that the user wants it. These are proposed protocol choices, not a validated three-label benchmark.

Pilot the rubric, then have two annotators independently code the same feedback and evidence. Report raw agreement, nominal Krippendorff’s alpha, label counts, confusion patterns, and insufficient-information frequency; retain judgments before adjudication. Measure agreement on interpreting feedback and factual support, rather than expecting different users to share preferences. Keep simulated judgments distinct from real user responses: [Soboroff (2025)](https://www.nist.gov/publications/dont-use-llms-make-relevance-judgments) cautions against replacing human relevance judgments with LLM labels. Use these annotations as descriptive diagnostics; retain macro validation HR@10 for selection and fit no additional scorer.
